messages:
incbot: INCIDENT detected — GPU OOM during prefill on cluster eu-prod-gpu-12. service=inference-runtime. containers restarting (3/21) · error rate +5%. paging on-call now.

sara (oncall): on it. @mike.d are you available? seeing alerts for cudaAlloc failure on prefill path.

mike.d: joining. pulling logs now.

mike.d: logs show repeated failures during prefill of long contexts (>65k tokens). sample:
```
[2026-03-17T02:14:33Z] ERROR runtime.prefill: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation: unable to allocate 2413621760 bytes for kv_cache
[2026-03-17T02:14:33Z] WARN runtime.prefill: prefill length=67212 tokens, model=redwood-xxl-65k, container=eu-prod-gpu-12-pod-7
```

sara (oncall): preliminary mitigation plan:
1) reduce PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS to 32768 on affected GPU pool
2) enable KV_CACHE_EVICTION=1 to free cold entries
3) route long-context traffic (path /api/v1/long-context) to smaller-model fallback (redwood-xl-8k) for 20% traffic
4) restart containers after env change

mike.d: executing step 1+4 for pool eu-prod-gpu-12 now:
```
kubectl set env deployment/inference-runtime PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=32768 -n prod --selector=pool=eu-prod-gpu-12
kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime -n prod --selector=pool=eu-prod-gpu-12
```

opsbot: Annotated incident: mitigation_job_created id=MJ-4821. Severity set to SEV2. Channel bridge opened.

mike.d: env applied to 2/3 nodes, rolling restart in progress. containers restarting, 1 crash seen and auto-restarted. tailing logs shows fewer OOMs so far.

alex.r: routing change prepared. applying weighted routing 80/20 (primary/fallback):
```
POST /internal/router/weights
payload: { "route":"/api/v1/long-context", "weights": {"redwood-xxl-65k": 0.8, "redwood-xl-8k": 0.2} }
```

mike.d: routing applied. metrics show error-rate dropping from +5% -> +1.2% over 8m.

julia.cs: customer-impact check: affected customers identified — AcmeCorp (enterprise), writeflow-beta, searchly-trial. Any ETA for full recovery so I can update them?

sara (oncall): ETA ~30-45m for full mitigation. I'll draft a short customer note and share.

sara (oncall): drafting:
"We experienced GPU prefill OOMs affecting long-context requests. We've mitigated by limiting prefill length and routing some long-context traffic to a smaller model. Systems are returning to normal; we'll follow up with root cause and long-term fix."

leo (night-oncall): taking over in ~35m. @sara please handoff anything outstanding.

sara (oncall): handing off — actions left: monitor for recurrence for 1hr, validate KV cache eviction behaviour, follow up with infra to schedule kernel-level memory tracing. Logs saved at /var/log/runtime/prefill/4815162342.log. Filed bug RT-987 for memory accounting in kv cache.

mike.d: confirmed logs and metrics retained, and a temporary dashboard card added: Metrics > incidents > 4815162342.

opsbot: Bridge closed by opsbot — leaving thread open for handoff messages.

sara (oncall): tagging final: incident moved to post-incident review queue. I'll prepare summary for retro.

leo (night-oncall): taking handoff, will watch overnight. ping me if anything spikes. :thumbsup:
